name: zn15_44_default_alpha_without_property
description: ZG18 (zones §10.1, the default-alpha table): Init's tuning read copies the alpha to the default alpha whenever the exemplar is found, also when it has no Zone Display Alpha (0xE94825B7). A manager initialised with an exemplar whose alpha is 128 has alpha 128 and default 128 and saves 128. A fresh manager loaded from that record has alpha 128 and the default alpha 0xFF (not saved; FreeCity4's constructor value). Init with an exemplar that has only Zone Min Cell Size: the alpha stays the saved 128 and the default alpha becomes a copy of it (128; before ZG18 it stayed 0xFF). Loaded again and initialised with no exemplar at all: both alphas are left as they were (128, 0xFF).
